channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Cláudio Castro e o dinheiro dos aposentados no Banco Master - O Assunto #1728
item.description: Former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro is targeted in the eighth phase of Operation Compliance Zero for allegedly facilitating a R$ 3.7 billion investment from the Rioprevidência pension fund into troubled assets at Banco Master, linked to Daniel Vorcaro. Investigators cite a close personal relationship between Castro and Vorcaro as key to the scheme, and report that Flávio Bolsonaro contacted Vorcaro even after the PL-RJ leadership knew of the impropriety. Castro’s Senate candidacy is now seen as politically dead by the PL leadership.

item.title: Encontro de Flávio e Trump vira meme nas redes sociais
item.description: A meeting between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and U.S. President Donald Trump at the White House became a viral meme on social media, featuring AI-generated images depicting the senator in subservient roles. The meeting, arranged by Eduardo Bolsonaro and journalist Paulo Figueiredo, lasted between 1 hour and 1 hour 40 minutes, according to reports, and ended with document delivery and a photo in the Oval Office. Neither Bolsonaro brother confirmed the exact duration of the encounter.

item.title: Governistas chamam encontro de Flávio e Trump de cortina de fumaça
item.description: PT government allies criticized Flávio Bolsonaro's meeting with Donald Trump at the White House, calling it a 'smokescreen' to divert attention from controversies linking him to former banker Daniel Vorcaro. Officials including Guilherme Boulos, Lindbergh Farias, and José Dirceu accused the senator of seeking a photo op with Trump to avoid scrutiny over an alleged scheme to divert R$4 billion from RioPrevidência via the Master Group. Boulos mocked the Bolsonaro family's subservience to the U.S., while Dirceu claimed the trip aimed to 'conspire against Brazil'.

item.title: Caiado é o pré-candidato com melhor “condição moral”, diz Leite
item.description: Governor Eduardo Leite (PSD) of Rio Grande do Sul stated that Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) is the presidential pre-candidate with the best 'moral condition' to lead Brazil, praising his management capacity, political articulation, and emotional intelligence. Leite criticized other candidates, specifically mentioning Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) for having ties he considers tainted with Daniel Vorcaro, founder of Banco Master, and said Caiado is the only one who possesses the necessary qualities to govern in a complex country like Brazil, despite acknowledging personal disagreements with the pre-candidate.

item.title: Bolsonaristas elogiam encontro entre Flávio e Trump
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) met with U.S. President Donald Trump at the White House on May 26, 2026. The meeting drew praise from Bolsonaro supporters, who highlighted discussions on public security, organized crime, and the legal situation of Jair Bolsonaro. PL lawmakers welcomed the encounter as a significant step in Flávio’s potential presidential campaign.

item.title: Congresso da Bolívia abre caminho para que presidente possa conter protestos com militares
item.description: Bolivia's Congress approved the removal of a 2020 norm that limited the president's ability to declare states of exception, now allowing Rodrigo Paz to deploy the military to contain protests demanding his resignation. The measure passed the Chamber of Deputies with over two-thirds support, following prior Senate approval, clearing the legal path for exceptional executive authority amid escalating unrest.

item.title: Decreto de Lula sobre redes com atribuições para agência fiscalizadora gera debate sobre legalidade
item.description: President Lula's (PT) government issued a decree assigning new social media regulation functions to a regulatory agency, sparking debate over the measure's legality. Lawyers and constitutional law professors consulted by Folha question whether the Executive can, via decree, grant such authority without explicit legislative authorization.

item.title: Lula omitiu até de amigos que precisaria de radioterapia e tenta mostrar vitalidade para eleição
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva did not disclose beforehand that he would need radiotherapy sessions after the removal of a low-aggressiveness skin cancer from his scalp, even to close allies and members of his inner circle. The omission of the treatment was intended to maintain an image of vitality ahead of the 2026 elections, according to sources.

item.title: Operação contra Castro agrava cenário em reduto de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: A Federal Police operation against former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro (PL) on Tuesday (26) intensifies pressure on Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a pre-candidate for president, in his electoral base. The action weakens Bolsonarist political articulations in Rio, already marked by investigations and institutional wear. The episode reinforces narratives of corruption and fragility within the allied party structure tied to the former president.

item.title: Flávio comete gafe e confunde Lula com Trump
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, mistakenly referred to Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva as Donald Trump during a press interaction in Washington, shortly after meeting with Trump at the White House. He quickly corrected himself, calling it a slip of the tongue. The incident occurred amid a U.S. visit organized by his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro and journalist Paulo Figueiredo, while Secretary of State Marco Rubio was in India.

item.title: Dirceu diz que Flávio foi “se esconder” na Casa Branca
item.description: Former minister José Dirceu accused Senator Flávio Bolsonaro of 'hiding' in the White House during his U.S. trip to avoid accountability over the Master case, involving alleged R$4 billion embezzlement from RioPrevidência. Dirceu claimed Flávio was negotiating with Donald Trump and making promises, including his brother Eduardo allegedly seeking sanctions against Brazilian Supreme Court ministers, while stressing that the truth will be decided in Brazil’s elections.

item.title: Boulos debocha de Zema e Caiado como oposição de Lula
item.description: Minister Guilherme Boulos (Psol-SP) criticized pre-candidates Romeu Zema (Novo) and Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), calling Zema 'incompetent' and 'unqualified' and accusing Caiado of ties to companies suspected of money laundering. He stated that the Bolsonaro family remains the only significant opposition force to Lula, despite investigations involving Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Do ponto de vista dos empresários, debate sobre o fim da escala 6x1 já está perdido na Câmara
item.description: From the perspective of business leaders, the debate over ending the 6x1 work schedule in the Chamber of Deputies is already lost, as there is a pre-established agreement between Chamber President Hugo Motta and the government set to be voted on this week in a special committee. According to columnist Fernando Schüler, private sector representatives, including Fiesp president Paulo Skaf, are lobbying the Senate to introduce economic analysis and productivity impact assessments in the second stage of the debate — elements missing in the Chamber’s proceedings. He challenges the claim that reducing the workweek to 44 hours in the 1990s had no economic impact, noting Brazil’s productivity has stagnated for over 30 years and that costs will not simply vanish in the economy.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro reforça manter pré-candidatura após episódio de áudio com Vorcaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) reaffirmed his 2026 presidential pre-candidacy after a press meeting with Donald Trump in Washington, denying that the audio scandal with Daniel Vorcaro constituted a campaign crisis. He demanded explanations from Lula regarding his ties to Vorcaro and Vorcaro’s fugitive son, while advocating for the installation of the CPMI on the Master Bank.

item.title: Governo vê risco para pauta comercial em visita de Flávio a Trump
item.description: The Lula government is concerned that the meeting between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and President Donald Trump could pose risks to the trade agenda between Brazil and the United States. The visit occurs at a sensitive time for bilateral relations, with fears that the senator’s ideological positions could interfere with economic negotiations.

item.title: TSE homologa alterações nos estatutos dos partidos Democrata e Unidade Popular
item.description: The TSE partially approved statutory amendments for the Democrats and Popular Unity (UP) parties, granting them 90 days to comply. For the Democrats, the Court required adjustments to limit provisional party organs to four years and clarify that financial contributions are voluntary. For UP, the Court mandated explicit inclusion of provisional organ terms and measures to combat political violence against women.

item.title: TSE confirma mandato de vereador do PSB na Câmara Municipal de Marabá (PA)
item.description: The TSE confirmed the mandate of councilor Orlando da Silva Elias (PSB) in Marabá’s Municipal Chamber, overturning the TRE-PA’s decision that had annulled his diploma over alleged gender quota fraud. By majority, the Court ruled there is no solid evidence of fraud involving candidate Gilmara da Silva Brito, noting that a zero vote count alone does not automatically constitute illegality.

item.title: Vice-líder do governo Lula pede que PF investigue Caiado por transações com fintech suspeita
item.description: Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ), vice-leader of the Lula government in the Chamber of Deputies, requested the Federal Police to investigate former Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) over alleged transactions between the state government and a fintech linked to Operation Carbono Oculto.

item.title: PSDB-Cidadania oficializam convite a Aécio Neves para disputa à Presidência
item.description: The PSDB-Cidadania federation formally invited federal deputy Aécio Neves (PSDB-MG) to run for president in the 2026 elections, following a unanimous endorsement at a meeting in Brasília with support from the coalition and Solidariedade representatives. No deadline has been set for his decision, as he is also considering running for a Senate seat from Minas Gerais. Aécio stated he does not see a future path in current candidacies, criticizing polarization and saying part of the population feels indignant and anguished by the available options.

item.title: A gafe de Flávio Bolsonaro após encontro com Donald Trump na Casa Branca
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a 2026 presidential pre-candidate, made a gaffe by initially claiming the invitation to meet Donald Trump at the White House came from President Lula, before correcting himself. He asked Trump to designate the PCC and CV as terrorist organizations, contrasting it with Lula’s alleged stance. The meeting, not on Trump’s official schedule, followed controversies involving requests for funds from banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance a biopic of Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Flávio: Reunião com Trump mostra 'prestígio' do Brasil e reconhecimento de alternativa a Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for presidency, stated that his meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump was not mediated by any businessman, referencing reports that Brazilian businessman Joesley Batista facilitated Lula’s meeting with Trump. He framed the meeting as evidence of Brazil’s international prestige and recognition of a political alternative to Lula’s government.

item.title: PSDB e Cidadania acertam pré-candidatura de Aécio, que ainda avalia
item.description: Aécio Neves received unanimous support from the PSDB Cidadania Federation to be a pre-candidate for the 2026 presidency, though he has not yet accepted the invitation, stating he will analyze the economic reaction. The move aims to position him as an alternative to the polarization between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, following the PSDB's decline in São Paulo and the 2024 municipal elections.

item.title: Zema já admite aliança com Caiado: “Eu gosto dele”
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) signaled that a political alliance with Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), former governor of Goiás, is under consideration for the 2026 presidential elections. Speaking at an investor event in São Paulo, Zema praised Caiado, saying 'I like him,' and did not rule out forming a joint ticket. The rapprochement suggests a potential center-right strategy to unite forces against the current government.

item.title: Em ato falho, Flávio diz que foi à Casa Branca a convite do 'presidente Lula' e se corrige em seguida; VÍDEO
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, senator and pre-candidate for president, made a slip of the tongue by claiming he was invited to the White House by President Lula, then quickly corrected himself to say the invitation came from Donald Trump. During the interview in Washington, he criticized Lula, urged Trump to designate PCC and CV as foreign terrorist organizations, and pledged to bring Brazil into the Shield of the Americas if elected.

item.title: Trump recibe a Bolsonaro hijo en el Despacho Oval tres semanas después de Lula
item.description: Trump received Flávio Bolsonaro in the Oval Office, reinforcing U.S. support for the son of former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro. The meeting took place three weeks after Trump had met with Lula in the same location. Flávio Bolsonaro’s team believes the photo with the U.S. president could reverse his declining popularity and strengthen his bid for the 2026 presidential election.

item.title: O argumento da embaixada do Brasil nos EUA para negar pedido de Flávio
item.description: The Brazilian Embassy in Washington denied Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's request to hold a press conference at its premises following his meeting with President Donald Trump, stating he was not on an official visit and that the Senate had not formally notified the embassy of such a mission. The embassy noted it had previously supported official delegations of opposition senators in 2025, including former Bolsonaro ministers, who held similar events with proper legislative authorization. Flávio subsequently held the press conference at a private venue in Washington.

item.title: TRUMP RECEBE FLÁVIO BOLSONARO: Senador visita a Casa Branca em meio ao caso Master
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro visited U.S. President Donald Trump at the White House amid leaks of messages related to the R$134 million financing of the documentary “Dark Horse,” known as the Master case. The visit occurs as public scrutiny grows over the origins and use of funds in the audiovisual project linked to the Bolsonaro family. The meeting with Trump underscores the international dimension of the Bolsonaro clan’s political alliances amid ongoing investigations.

item.title: Flávio critica Embaixada do Brasil nos EUA: "Extensão partidária do PT"
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) criticized the Brazilian Embassy in the U.S. for denying use of its facilities for a press conference, calling it a 'partisan extension of the PT'. He argued that Brazilian diplomacy must serve the nation, not political interests, and denounced ideological capture of public institutions following his meeting with Donald Trump at the White House.

item.title: CONTRASTE DE AGENDAS: Janja supera Lula em dias fora do Brasil
item.description: First Lady Janja has spent more days abroad than President Lula in 2025, according to a report by O Antagonista. Her international agenda includes participation in global forums, humanitarian missions, and diplomatic representations. The data suggests a more active international presence by Janja compared to the president, who has remained predominantly in Brazil.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro posta foto de Flávio ao lado de retrato de Trump
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro shared on social media a photo of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro inside the White House, standing beside a portrait of former U.S. President Donald Trump. The photo was taken after an unofficial meeting between Flávio, his brother Eduardo, and blogger Paulo Figueiredo with Trump, during which the senator gifted the U.S. president Brazil national team jerseys. The meeting, lasting about ninety minutes, was not listed in the White House’s official schedule.

item.title: Nikolas elogia visita de Flávio a Trump: “Importante aproximação”
item.description: Nikolas Ferreira praised Flávio Bolsonaro's visit to Donald Trump, calling it an 'important rapprochement'. Flávio discussed the possibility of the U.S. designating PCC and CV as terrorist groups, a move the Lula government opposes due to fears of foreign interference. The meeting, not listed in the White House's official schedule, included Eduardo Bolsonaro and Paulo Figueiredo, with Flávio planning further talks with U.S. officials, though Secretary of State Marco Rubio is currently in India.

item.title: Fux segue Cármen Lúcia e vota por derrubar mudanças na Lei da Ficha Limpa
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Luiz Fux followed Justice Cármen Lúcia's vote to overturn amendments to the Clean Record Law that would have changed the start of the eight-year ineligibility period from the end of the sentence to the date of conviction. The action, filed by the Sustainability Network, argues the Senate made substantive changes without returning the bill to the Chamber of Deputies, violating bicameralism. The amendments would have benefited politicians such as Anthony Garotinho, José Roberto Arruda, and Eduardo Cunha by reducing their ineligibility period.

item.title: Diplomatas defendem posição da Embaixada nos EUA sobre Flávio: “Defeso eleitoral”
item.description: Brazilian diplomats defended the Embassy in the U.S.'s decision to deny Flávio Bolsonaro’s request for a press briefing, citing the late, informal submission of the request and its electoral nature, which violates pre-electoral neutrality rules and the defeso eleitoral framework. They stressed that using embassies for partisan political activity undermines the integrity of Brazil’s foreign policy and that the Embassy represents the Brazilian state, not any candidate or party.

item.title: A reclamação de Flávio sobre postura da Embaixada do Brasil em Washington
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's team complained that the Brazilian Embassy in Washington denied them support to hold a press briefing after his meeting with Donald Trump, accusing the embassy of partisan bias favoring the Lula government. They argued the embassy should remain neutral and serve the Brazilian state, not political interests. The Itamaraty did not comment by the time of publication.

item.title: Flávio critica embaixada por não ceder espaço para entrevista
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) criticized the Brazilian Embassy in the U.S. for refusing to provide space for a press interview following his meeting with President Donald Trump, accusing the embassy of acting as a 'partisan extension of the PT' and using public facilities selectively for ideological convenience. He had requested the space in advance but received no response, emphasizing that diplomacy should serve the Brazilian state, not political interests.

item.title: Bolsonaristas comemoram visita de Flávio a Trump, enquanto esquerda ironiza foto do encontro nas redes
item.description: Allies of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro celebrated his meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump at the White House, where they urged the U.S. to designate Brazilian criminal factions as terrorist organizations. The left mocked the encounter on social media, while Bolsonarists such as Eduardo Bolsonaro, Nikolas Ferreira, and Sergio Moro highlighted the meeting as a demonstration of strength and prestige.

item.title: Racha no bolsonarismo expõe disputa por poder em São Paulo e respinga em Flávio
item.description: Bolsonarism is experiencing a 'complete chaos' marked by internal conflicts among Bolsonaro family allies, with public disputes over Senate and state government slots, especially in São Paulo between Ricardo Salles and André do Prado, already affecting Eduardo Bolsonaro. Michelle Bolsonaro is also cited as a source of discomfort among allies due to her support for Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential pre-campaign, which faces coordination difficulties.

item.title: STF tem dois votos para derrubar mudança na Lei da Ficha Limpa que reduz prazo de inelegibilidade
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) has two votes in favor of overturning the amendment to the Clean Record Law that reduced the ineligibility period, with Ministers Cármén Lúcia and Luiz Fux arguing the change weakens the law and represents a setback. The 2025 law changed the count of ineligibility to start from the decision of mandate loss, not the end of the mandate, benefiting removed officials. The virtual plenary judgment continues until Friday, with eight justices yet to vote.

item.title: Flávio: Expressei a Trump 'diferença gritante' que haverá entre governo Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, said he told U.S. President Donald Trump about the 'glaring difference' between a potential Bolsonaro government and the current Lula administration. The statement was made on Tuesday, the 26th, as part of his political positioning in the pre-campaign period.

item.title: Valdemar diz que fala sobre Flávio buscar dinheiro com Vorcaro em visita foi tirada de contexto
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, national president of the PL, stated that his comment regarding Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's visit to banker Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master was taken out of context. He said the remark was decontextualized and did not reflect its original intent.

item.title: Estrategista digital de Bolsonaro deixa pré-campanha de Flávio
item.description: Digital strategist Marcos Aurélio Carvalho, a key figure in Jair Bolsonaro’s 2018 presidential campaign, departed Flávio Bolsonaro’s pre-campaign digital team after completing the initial phase of diagnosis, positioning, and strategic organization. His exit marks the third departure from the candidate’s communications team since the audio leak in which the senator asked for money from Banco Master founder Daniel Vorcaro. The campaign, now under the political leadership of Rogério Marinho, has restructured with Eduardo Fischer taking over strategy and Alexandre Oltramari leading marketing efforts.

item.title: Caso Master: O avanço entre governo Lula e DF para tentar salvar o BRB
item.description: The Lula government and the Federal District have advanced in an agreement to resolve BRB's financial crisis, involving a loan to the Operations Guarantor Fund guaranteed by private banks, with the DF offering its monthly federal transfers as collateral. The Union will adjust the DF's debt ceiling under the PRAF, while STF Minister Luiz Fux must still validate the terms at a conciliation hearing set for May 28. BRB faces a R$6.6 billion debt due to fraudulent transactions with Banco Master.

item.title: Flávio diz que pediu a Trump que classifique PCC e CV como terroristas
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for the Brazilian presidency, met with Donald Trump at the White House on May 26, 2026, to urge the U.S. to designate Brazil's PCC and CV criminal factions as terrorist organizations. He stated he made the explicit request, while the Lula government opposes the move, citing risks of foreign interference. The meeting, not listed in Trump's official schedule, included his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro and journalist Paulo Figueiredo.

item.title: Foto de Flávio Bolsonaro com Trump simboliza a identidade mundial da direita
item.description: The photo of Flávio Bolsonaro with Donald Trump symbolizes the global identity of the right, reinforcing affective loyalty among voters that transcends scandals and criticism. This tribal sense of belonging explains why Flávio maintains support despite controversial audio leaks, while the left seeks to portray him as a sellout and the right sees him as a symbol of a movement beyond Brazilian borders.

item.title: Flávio acusa Itamaraty de agir como “extensão partidária do PT”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) accused the Itamaraty of acting as a partisan extension of the PT after the Brazilian embassy in Washington denied him support to speak with the press following his meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump at the White House. The criticism was issued by his team on Tuesday, the 26th.

item.title: Após pedido de Flávio a Trump, entenda por que governo não quer que as facções sejam classificadas como terroristas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro met with Donald Trump at the White House and urged him to designate the PCC and Comando Vermelho as foreign terrorist organizations. The Brazilian government, represented by Lula, did not raise the issue in its meeting with Trump and has resisted the classification, fearing damage to bilateral relations and domestic crime-fighting strategies. The proposal had been under consideration by the Trump administration since 2025, with Secretary of State Marco Rubio advocating for including Brazilian factions on the terrorist list, although Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira attempted to dissuade him.

item.title: ‘Muitas questões que precisa explicar’, diz Tarcísio sobre relação de Flávio com Vorcaro
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas said Senator Flávio Bolsonaro must explain his ties to former banker Daniel Vorcaro, linked to the Master Bank scandal and the funding of the Dark Horse film honoring Jair Bolsonaro. He stated that society is on alert and that full clarification is needed, denying any distancing between himself and Flávio after the audio leak by The Intercept Brasil. Tarcísio confirmed he will attend the March for Jesus in June but does not know if Flávio will attend, emphasizing he will only focus on elections during the campaign period.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que Flávio Bolsonaro precisa explicar relação com Vorcaro
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas stated that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro still needs to clarify his relationship with banker Daniel Vorcaro, who is under investigation for fraud at Banco Master, particularly regarding the financing of the film 'Dark Horse'. Despite the criticism, Tarcísio denied any political distancing and confirmed Flávio remains an ally, noting that his recent trip to the U.S. to meet with Donald Trump is natural for someone positioning himself as a presidential pre-candidate.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz ter pedido a Trump que classifique PCC e CV como terroristas
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) claims he requested U.S. President Donald Trump to designate the PCC and Comando Vermelho as terrorist organizations during a meeting at the White House. He contrasted his stance with the Lula government, which he says urges the U.S. not to make such a designation. The meeting took place amid declining poll numbers following allegations that Flávio sought funding from a banker for a film about his father.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz ter pedido para Donald Trump classificar PCC e CV como terroristas
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) said he asked Donald Trump to designate the PCC and CV as terrorist organizations during a meeting in Washington. He criticized Lula for seeking to avoid such a designation and expressed interest in forming international agreements to combat Brazilian criminal factions. The U.S. government has been analyzing for over a year whether to label groups like PCC and CV as terrorists, having already done so with Mexican cartels and Venezuela’s Tren de Aragua.
